steps.speaker: Mira
steps.title: A Side Quest!
steps.body:
Interesting — someone in town has a job for you. Side quests appear when you return from a dungeon run. There are three types:

- Hunt: Slay specific monsters in regular dungeon combat
- Resupply: Gather materials and turn them in
- Mini-Dungeon: Fight through a short chain of elite encounters right from town

steps.speaker: Mira
steps.title: Tracking Progress
steps.body:
Open the Quest Log from the left menu to check your progress. It shows your Main Story objective at the top and any active side quests below — including how close you are to completing each one.

Hunt quests track kills automatically during dungeon combat. Resupply quests check your stash when you return to town.

steps.speaker: Mira
steps.title: Rare Rewards
steps.body:
Complete a side quest and you'll receive Rare or Epic equipment as a reward — much better than what you'll find in normal dungeon drops. The reward is added straight to your Storage.

You can have one quest of each type active at a time. Higher-tier regions offer side quests more often.
